responsibility: Implements symbolic byte-offset and byte-range utilities used by the analyzer’s memory and bounds reasoning. This file converts region offsets into byte-based svalues, prints and serializes symbolic offsets/ranges, computes derived endpoints such as last and next byte positions, and uses region_model constraint evaluation to answer whether two symbolic ranges definitely intersect, definitely do not, or remain unknown, with selftests covering concrete and symbolic cases.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of the symbolic byte-offset and byte-range types declared in ranges.h, including dumping/JSON support, derived-endpoint computation, intersection reasoning against region_model constraints, and file-local selftests.
